limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses immortalized fibroblasts, which may not fully recapitulate primary CAF behaviour.
In vivo experiments were performed in subcutaneous matrix plugs, not orthotopic tumours.
The feed-forward loop model is based on in vitro and in vivo data; direct evidence of the loop in human tumours is not provided.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that YAP depletion reduces focal adhesions in CAFs.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: YAP-depleted cells also had fewer focal adhesions, essential structures for force transmission between the cytoskeleton and matrix (Fig. 4b).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that YAP depletion reduces thick collagen fibres and elastic modulus of matrices.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: These defects were associated with fewer thick collagen fibres within matrices containing YAP-depleted cells together with a lower elastic modulus (Fig. 4c).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that YAP depletion reduces fibrous collagen networks and angiogenesis in vivo.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Depletion of YAP also reduced the ability of CAFs to form fibrous collagen networks and promote angiogenesis in vivo (Fig. 4f—Masson’s trichrome and endomucin staining, respectively).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that activation of YAP signalling (by active mutant or MST1/2 depletion) increases invasion-promoting ability of NFs.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Conversely, activation of YAP signalling by either overexpression of an active mutant or depletion of MST1&2 increased invasion-promoting ability of NFs (Supplementary Fig. S4b,g).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that YAP regulates MYL9 and MYH10 protein levels (not transcriptionally) and that this is critical for CAF function.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Figure 5d shows that depletion of YAP, but not TAZ, reduces both the total levels of MYL9 and MYH10 and the level of active Ser 19 phosphorylated MYL9.

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that conditioned media from cancer cells promotes YAP nuclear translocation and target gene activation in NFs, and that this is blocked by actomyosin inhibition.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: This change in behaviour was also associated with the nuclear translocation of YAP and the activation of some YAP/TAZ target genes (Fig. 6b,c).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that ROCK inhibition reduces YAP target gene expression in CAFs.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: This is associated with reduced nuclear localization of YAP and reduced expression of several, but not all, YAP target genes (Fig. 6e,f).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that acute inhibition of ROCK, myosin, and Src reduces nuclear YAP in CAFs even after ECM remodelling, demonstrating requirement for sensing rigidity.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: These experiments reveal that ROCK, myosin and Src function (blocked by PP2 and dasatinib) are required to maintain the nuclear localization of YAP in CAFs, even after the ECM has been remodelled.

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that ROCK inhibition reduces Src activity and that Src acts downstream of cytoskeletal tension to regulate YAP.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Further, ROCK inhibition reduced Src activity (Supplementary Fig. S5e). Thus, we propose that Src acts downstream43 from cytoskeletal tension to regulate YAP.

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that blebbistatin, Y27632, and dasatinib reduce YAP association with TEAD1/4 and increase association with 14-3-3.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: However, blebbistatin, Y27632 and dasatinib all reduced the association of YAP with TEAD1 and TEAD4, but increased its association with 14-3-3 proteins (Fig. 7d).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that YAP is required for elevated MYL9 and MYH10 levels and matrix stiffening by CAFs.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: YAP is required for elevated levels of MYL9 and MYH10 and matrix stiffening by CAFs (Fig. 5).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the core result that transient ROCK inhibition leads to long-lasting reversion of CAF phenotype (defective matrix remodelling after drug removal).
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Figure 7e shows that Y27632 effectively reduced matrix remodelling when included during the assay. More notably, cells that had previously been cultured in Y27632, but were assayed in normal media, showed significantly defective matrix remodelling abilities 3–5 days after removal of the drug (Fig. 6l).
